instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript .js / .jsx file extensions for all React components.
Implement language state management so the entire UI seamlessly switches between Spanish and English.
Ensure 9:16 aspect ratio vertical video preview is realistic, showing animated cartoon slide, camera motion indicators, synchronized voice wave preview, and subtitles.
Implement ElevenLabs voice dropdowns with voice preview audio snippets and tone options (e.g., Sarcastic, Excited, Deadpan, Screaming, Goofy).
Provide Creatomate assembly pipeline simulation with real status updates (Assembly, Sound Effects Layering, Subtitle Alignment, MP4 Rendering) and detailed cost estimation breakdown ($/video).
Add retry mechanism UI for handling simulated or actual API failures with exponential backoff status indicators.
Include sample pre-loaded funny jokes in both Spanish and English (e.g. '¿Qué hace una abeja en el gimnasio? ¡Buzz-ba!', 'Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything!').
All interactive elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use dark colors as heavy full-screen gradient overlays.
Maintain high APCA / WCAG text contrast for all buttons, input labels, and active states.
Containers with borders must always have generous padding (p-4 to p-8) to prevent visual crowding.
Use direct grid children when utilizing framer-motion wrapped elements.
Always set explicit hover text colors (e.g. hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
Never hide primary navigation on desktop browsers.
